title: Build and verify Fallen Knight datapack boss for Minecraft 26.1.2
objective: Implement the approved Fallen Knight midgame boss as a datapack-driven, multiplayer-safe encounter for Minecraft Java 26.1.2 with repeatable castle rematches, per-player progression, and a swappable resource-pack visual layer.
acceptance_criteria: Gameplay targets exactly Minecraft Java 26.1.2 and validates against Java 25 runtime behavior
The datapack implements independent multiplayer-safe castle encounters with per-player rewards and reconnect-safe pending rewards
Phase 1 and Phase 2 boss combat follow the approved Fallen Knight design and remain fair/readable without custom Java code
Knight's Oath rematches work at cleared castles and consume offerings without consuming the persistent relic
Static tests and exact-runtime validation pass before completion
The resource pack remains optional for gameplay correctness
